thesis_statement: Microsoft combines the Azure cloud platform, Microsoft 365 and a deep enterprise distribution base, making it one of the most direct ways enterprises buy AI; Azure passing $100B in annual revenue and 30M+ paid Copilot seats show AI is already producing revenue.

base.summary: Revenue grows in the mid-teens with operating margin near 45% as Azure AI demand offsets higher depreciation.
drivers: Azure AI and core cloud consumption

bull.summary: AI monetization accelerates and capex intensity peaks, lifting free cash flow growth.
drivers: Azure capacity additions converting to revenue

bear.summary: Capex keeps rising faster than cloud revenue, compressing free cash flow and the multiple.

key_risks: Free cash flow fell 23% year over year in Q2 2026 as quarterly capex reached $35.8B.
GAAP results are affected by AI investment accounting (OpenAI losses and a $3.2B Anthropic gain); use non-GAAP for trend.
Valuation (forward P/E ~22) assumes AI returns arrive on schedule.
